data.gender_notes: Tull is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word ‘tullus’, meaning ‘horn’. In ancient Rome, a horn symbolized power and prosperity. In Christian tradition, Tull can symbolize the horn of salvation or the horn of God's protection. The name Tull carries the meaning “Horn, Prosperous” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Tull usually hope their child will grow to embody horn, prosperous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of God's protection and strength.
